name: SS Mayflower
builder: R. & W. Hawthorn, Leslie & Co. Ltd., Hebburn-on-Tyne
summary: A large early-twentieth-century transatlantic steamship associated briefly with the Dominion Line, she was launched in 1902 as Hanoverian for the Leyland Line and made her first Liverpool–Boston voyage that July; In 1903 she entered Dominion Line service under the name Mayflower , a historically loaded name that deliberately echoed English migration memory while the ship herself served the practical passenger-and-emigrant traffic of the North Atlantic.
